Senior Backend Engineer — Payments Platform (Remote, US)
Northwind Pay

About the role
Northwind Pay is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build the services that move money for thousands of businesses. You will design and operate high-throughput, fault-tolerant systems and help raise the engineering bar across the team.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate microservices in Go that process millions of payment transactions per day
- Own event-driven architecture built on Kafka, including schema evolution and exactly-once processing
- Improve performance and reliability of PostgreSQL-backed APIs; define SLOs and lead incident response
- Run workloads on AWS and Kubernetes; manage infrastructure as code with Terraform
- Mentor engineers, lead design reviews and partner with product managers

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of backend software engineering experience
- Strong experience with Go (or willingness to learn it coming from Java/Python)
- Distributed systems, microservices, gRPC and REST API design
- Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms
- PostgreSQL, Redis, query optimization
- AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD
- Experience in payments, fintech or other regulated environments is a plus
- On-call experience and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
